result: In a futuristic city, Dr. Evelyn Carter, a brilliant genetic engineer, has developed a revolutionary gene therapy that could cure all forms of cancer. However, her discovery is threatened by a powerful pharmaceutical company, GenoTech, which plans to steal her research and sell it at exorbitant prices. As Evelyn prepares to unveil her breakthrough at a prestigious conference, she uncovers a mole within her own team, who has been secretly working for GenoTech. The mole reveals that the company has planted a virus in the therapy, which will cause it to fail. With time running out, Evelyn must race against the clock to expose the mole and save her life-saving invention from falling into the wrong hands.
